purpose: P6-E modern official-code baseline applicability on the already-trained eight-class BloodMNIST victims; no victim retraining and no CF-CMD tuning

victims.checkpoint_policy: load the archived suspect checkpoints and verify seed receipts; do not retrain or alter weights

upstream.name: BackdoorBench AGPD
upstream.scope: feature-level architecture adapter using the upstream activation-gradient, class-anomaly, and progressive-filtering equations; not a bit-identical end-to-end BackdoorBench run

adapter.gradient: gradient of the assigned-class logit with respect to each convolution output, spatially averaged per sample
adapter.clean_reference: 12 correctly classified validation samples per class, sampled without replacement and then sorted with NumPy default_rng(20270929 + victim_seed); 96 total
adapter.tau_reason: the pinned upstream YAML omits tau; 0.5 is frozen before any run as the symmetric cutoff after upstream min-max normalization
declared_compatibility_repairs: accept an explicit ordered convolution-layer list instead of hard-coded ResNet/VGG names
use torch.autograd.grad on the assigned-class-logit sum with respect to the convolution output, which is mathematically equivalent to the upstream backward-hook gradient-output statistic
apply the 0.3 fallback over all available declared layers when fewer than four layers exist
if fewer than ten Jensen-Shannon updates exist, use one window spanning all available updates; always retain at least the initial farthest sample
when a progressive-filtering denominator is numerically zero, assign the neutral ratio 0.5
forbidden_changes: no seed-specific tau, layer, target-class, reference-size, or stopping-rule tuning
no poison labels in scoring or threshold selection
no clean checkpoint or drift view

development_gate.expansion_rule: run all five confirmation seeds only if every non-performance gate passes on both development seeds

reported_outputs: victim CA and ASR copied and independently checked from archived checkpoints
selected layer, target classes, per-layer rho and one-sided MAD anomaly scores
per-sample original index, original label, assigned label, poison truth, and AGPD flag
TPR, all-clean FPR, target-clean FPR, precision, and seed-level ranges
upstream hashes, adapter hash, checkpoint hashes, runtime, and declared repair activations

interpretation.positive: modern activation-gradient baseline is applicable under the declared feature-level adapter
interpretation.negative: a failed gate is an applicability or implementation-fidelity result, not proof that AGPD is generally ineffective
interpretation.comparison: compare operating points with SCAn/Spectral/SPECTRE descriptively; do not claim unified dominance because information and threshold assumptions differ
